text: Nintex Log to history list and audit logging actions write entries to a SharePoint list. In Power Automate use the SharePoint Create item action pointed at an audit list.
Nintex Call web service and Web request actions map to the Power Automate HTTP action with method, URI, headers and body.
Nintex notification to chat maps to the Microsoft Teams Post message in a chat or channel action.
Nintex Pause for and Pause until map to the Power Automate Delay and Delay until actions.
Nintex Update item sets fields on a list item. In Power Automate use the SharePoint Update item action.

target: No direct equivalent (Azure Function or Power Fx redesign)
text: Nintex Run script and custom code actions have no direct Power Automate equivalent. They must be redesigned using an Azure Function, an HTTP call or Power Fx expressions.
